criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following are true, with zero exceptions:
• Fits exactly one page.
• No overcrowding (visible white space between sections).
• Any photo used is professional, square-cropped, and passport-style.(not mandatory)
• Font/spacing is uniform across every section.
• No dark shaded blocks or uneven margins.
• The most job-relevant tagline with name/job-role/ Qualification e.g. (Sophomore Developer/Aspiring Tech Enthusiast)
criteria.satisfactory: Any one or two of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were not followed.
criteria.average: Any three or four of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were not followed.
criteria.dissatisfactory: None of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were followed.

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following:
• No tables, text boxes, columns, or embedded images used for layout.
• Exactly one font family throughout.
• Margins between 0.5"–1" on all sides.
• Font size 10–12pt for body text and consistent within each section.
• Special characters/bold/caps used consistently for the same purpose throughout (e.g., all section headers bold, never mixed).
• Bullets used for every list, no paragraph-style lists.
• No borders, shading, or non-standard colors.
criteria.satisfactory: Any one or two of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were not followed.
criteria.average: Any three or four of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were not followed.
criteria.dissatisfactory: Any five or none of the points mentioned in the “Highly Satisfactory” category were followed.

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following:
• Every section has a distinct, labeled heading.
• All entries within each section (Education, Projects, Experience, Achievements, Certifications, Trainings or any academic activity) are in strict reverse chronological order with no exceptions.
• No orphaned or miscategorized entries.

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following present and correctly formatted:
• Full name (largest/boldest text on the page). The name added should stand out in the resume.
• Contact Details: Phone number,LinkedIn Username hyperlinked with URL and other portfolios/website links.
• Professional email (firstname.lastname format or similar — no nicknames/numbers unrelated to name).

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following:
• Objective is 2–3 sentences (not 1 line, not a full paragraph).
• Explicitly names the target role/domain.
• States one specific skill or strength the student brings.
• Is written in the student's own words with zero generic/templated phrases ("seeking a challenging position," "to utilize my skills," "hardworking and dedicated individual" are automatic disqualifiers from this band). Trainer must have reviewed against the actual target JD.

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
ALL of the following for every entry:
• Usage of right terminology as secondary/senior secondary instead of roman numbers or 10th, +1, +2.
• Institution name, board/university affiliation, year of passing/expected, and CGPA/percentage all present for every entry with zero omissions.
• Degree names fully spelled out (not abbreviated as "B.Tech" without full form at least once).

criteria.highly_satisfactory:
• Interpersonal Skills mentioned are a depiction of unique personality. (for example, effective communication and not communication)
• The list is organized by category (e.g., Technical, Languages, Interpersonal Skills) for easy reading. It focuses only on relevant, honest skills and avoids over-crowding.
• The resume avoids simply listing abstract soft skills like "Leadership" or "Communication."
• Every major skill claimed is backed by a specific example or a brief accomplishment.
• The descriptions demonstrate how skills were applied in real-world scenarios (e.g., in a classroom, project, or club).
• Evidence provided is concise and directly supports the student's competence in that area.
